description: Upload a file to a SharePoint document library. Files over 4 MB are automatically chunked via an upload session.

conflict_behavior.description: How to handle name conflicts (default: replace).

content_type.description: MIME type of the file (default: application/octet-stream).

drive_id.description: Drive ID. Omit to use the site's default document library.

file_path.description: Destination path including filename, e.g. '/Shared Documents/reports/Q1.xlsx'.

name: upload_file
